en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a lush garden path lined with palm trees and dense greenery. Two people can be seen walking or standing in the distance along the path. The text on the front reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Palmengarten.' The reverse side has printed areas for correspondence and address, features a stamp from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' as well as other German text and publishing information.
